svg.title: U5 BOSLA: Job-market intelligence (DEPI R5 final project)
svg.desc: Pipeline + dashboard over 588,545 unique tech job postings from 8 sources, 159 countries and 1,475 skills, showing where the jobs are and what to learn next. Built with Data pipeline, Dashboard. flashed 2 weeks ago. Opens r5depifinalproject.vercel.app.
